purpose.zh: 低负荷练髋内旋的主动控制
purpose.en: Train low-load control of hip internal rotation.

text.zh: 大腿和膝盖不动，小腿慢慢向外摆
text.en: Keep your thigh and knee still and swing your lower leg slowly outward

text.zh: 站直，骨盆朝前，单手轻扶椅子
text.en: Stand tall, pelvis facing forward, one hand lightly on the chair.

text.zh: 在舒适范围内摆动，不扭膝盖和脚踝
text.en: Move in a comfortable range without twisting the knee or ankle.

commonErrors.en: Forcing the knee or ankle to twist.

cautions.zh: 每侧先做1组4–6次，疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Start with one easy set of 4–6 per side, and stop if it hurts.
